name: AeroCopilotBench Tier 2
protocol: Tier 2 frozen 73 tasks, three trials, native tools, high reasoning, 48 turns, task-balanced safety-gated SR; auxiliary metrics excluded.

explanation.en: A trial succeeds only when every goal is met with no hard safety violation; tasks are macro-averaged over three trials.
explanation.zh: 只有完成全部目标且无硬性安全违规时才成功；每题三次后进行任务等权平均。

summary.en: AeroCopilotBench evaluates safe emergency procedures in a deterministic virtual cockpit.
summary.zh: AeroCopilotBench 评估 agent 在确定性虚拟驾驶舱中安全执行紧急程序。

task_format.en: Diagnose cockpit state and use twelve tools to complete 73 emergency or abnormal procedures.
task_format.zh: 诊断驾驶舱状态并使用 12 类工具完成 73 个紧急或异常程序。
